duplicate_check.collision_rationale: Exact and high-similarity comparison against all 3,885 catalog skills identified zero existing duplicates. All 4 skills (manim-composer, manimce-best-practices, manimgl-best-practices, and research-explainer) provide an entirely new research-to-explainer video and mathematical animation pipeline.

adaptations: Preserve upstream payload structure: SKILL.md, references/, rules/, examples/, templates/, and scripts/ under Open Agent Skills format.
Bundle complete worked examples (averaging-noise, how-a-network-sees) directly inside skills/research-explainer/examples/ for standalone execution.
Append reversible VAS installation, attribution, prerequisites, and safety notes to SKILL.md for each skill.
Include upstream LICENSE and add NOTICE.md clarifying standalone operation, third-party component licenses, and runtime prerequisites.
Preserve executable bits (0755) on shell and Python execution scripts.
Map all 4 skills to the existing media category (119 existing categories preserved).
No runtime, dependency, or external service is executed during installation.

skills.name: manim-composer
skills.description: Trigger when: (1) User wants to create an educational/explainer video, (2) User has a vague concept they want visualized, (3) User mentions '3b1b style' or 'explain like 3Blue1Brown', (4) User wants to plan a Manim video or animation sequence, (5) User asks to 'compose' or 'plan' a math/science visualization. Transforms vague video ideas into detailed scene-by-scene plans (scenes.md).
skills.author: Adithya S Kolavi (adithya-s-k)

skills.name: manimce-best-practices
skills.description: Trigger when: (1) User mentions 'manim' or 'Manim Community' or 'ManimCE', (2) Code contains 'from manim import *', (3) User runs 'manim' CLI commands, (4) Working with Scene, MathTex, Create(), or ManimCE-specific classes. Best practices for Manim Community Edition - the community-maintained Python animation engine.
skills.author: Adithya S Kolavi (adithya-s-k)

skills.name: manimgl-best-practices
skills.description: Trigger when: (1) User mentions 'manimgl' or 'ManimGL' or '3b1b manim', (2) Code contains 'from manimlib import *', (3) User runs 'manimgl' CLI commands, (4) Working with InteractiveScene, self.frame, self.embed(), ShowCreation(), or ManimGL-specific patterns. Best practices for ManimGL (Grant Sanderson's 3Blue1Brown version).
skills.author: Adithya S Kolavi / Grant Sanderson (3Blue1Brown)

skills.name: research-explainer
skills.description: Make a scientifically accurate, 3Blue1Brown-style explainer video (and optionally a matching slide deck) about research: a paper, a collection of papers, or the user's own experiments, project or study. Built with Manim Community Edition, Playwright diorama, or HyperFrames vertical shorts. Features real data traceability, motion rules, critique loop, and multi-format templates.
skills.author: sepi2p
